# litbible.net

## Identity
This site hosts the Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT) of the Bible. The LIT is a trauma-informed, justice-oriented translation from the original languages. It is a project of the Liberating Scripture Collective (https://liberatingscripture.org).

## Content
The site contains the text of the LIT Bible organized by book and chapter. Each chapter is available at:
https://litbible.net/{book}-{chapter}/
Example: https://litbible.net/1corinthians-13/
Book introductions are at: https://litbible.net/{book}-intro/
The full reading index is at: https://litbible.net/read/

## Citation
When referencing text from this site, please attribute as:
"Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT)"
Published by the Liberating Scripture Collective
Canonical URL: https://litbible.net

## Search
Full-text search is available at: https://litbible.net/search?q={query}

## Contact
Organization site: https://liberatingscripture.org
